name: Kilowhy
track: 02 The Agent That Can Explain Why

sponsors.zetaris: All data (REST sources + sample files) queried through one local Zetaris SQL endpoint

meterless.provider: Nightshift (Runtime provider contract v4) as primary LLM provider, http://127.0.0.1:8088/v1

hmem.role: Investigation memory: notes the owner tells us and causes the agent confirmed, stored with provenance, recalled at the start of the next investigation (each recalled memory is an M# fact the answer may cite), every write and read audited in the trust ledger

functions: confirmCauses (supported causes written back with evidence ids, Zetaris run ids and Nightshift receipt ids)
investigate (recall at the start, M# facts, plan prompt, write at the end)

see_it_work: node scripts/note.ts --site S2 "Brixton moved its oven schedule 2 hours later from 7 Oct for the new sourdough line"
node scripts/ask.ts "Why did Brixton use more electricity?"  (before and after the note)
node scripts/note.ts --recall "Why did Brixton use more electricity?" --site S2
UI: memory panel (notes with provenance and ledger)

world-model.role: Grounded entities read from Zetaris: sites (with aliases such as Brixton), meters, contract, the Agile tariff and the flat comparison tariff, ops_log events as bitemporal edges and facts, each with provenance {view, zetarisRunId, at}; resolves the site a question names; re-ingest is idempotent

functions: resolveSite, mentionedSites (the engine's 0.85 / 0.82 resolve bands via nameSimilarity and decide)
investigate (sites step: ingest, then the site a question names is resolved through the world; an unknown site becomes a clarification)
addWorldEvents (the World Model's event count on the H4, H5 and H11 evidence)

see_it_work: node scripts/worldmodel_check.ts  (ingest twice from Zetaris: empty diff, entity/fact counts, resolutions)
node scripts/worldmodel_check.ts --mutate  (proof that the check can fail)
world-model.store: data/cache/worldmodel/.world/kilowhy.json when run with --local or through scripts/ask.ts (git-ignored)

markovian.role: The LLM part of an investigation as bounded chunks run by the engine's orchestrator: plan, interpret the hypothesis results in batches, narrative, verify; a compact JSON carryover (scope, hypothesis table, evidence ids, readings, open questions) is all that travels between chunks; tokens per chunk are logged against the reference's naive full-history estimate

functions: runMarkovianChain (Markovian.run with one stepFn per chunk kind)
fitState (keeps the carryover inside the 800-token budget)
totalsOf (estimated and measured tokens, naive baseline)
investigate (option engine: "markovian" by default, "plain" for the single plan + narrative loop)

see_it_work: node scripts/ask.ts "Why did Brixton use more electricity?"  (prints the chain: chunk, seconds, input tokens, naive tokens, carryover)
eval/markovian_tokens.json  (per-chunk token log of every run)
node scripts/markovian_latency.ts  (plain loop against the chain, live)

engines.check: node scripts/engines_check.ts  (each engine's own test suite: npm install + npm test in vendor/meterless/<engine>/reference)

sponsors.nvidia: Nemotron models via Nightshift, direct NVIDIA API as labelled secondary route; Nemotron embed 1B (provider.embed, labelled route) for H-MEM recall
sponsors.cursor: Cursor CLI used for generator and UI components; transcripts in docs/cursor-log/

pre_existing_open_source: Meterless H-MEM engine, vendor/meterless/hmem (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/Meterless/Meterless, commit 1742dec56a66e58eef9dda2d2b865823758ca8cd)
Meterless World Model engine, vendor/meterless/world-model (Apache-2.0, same commit)
Meterless Markovian engine, vendor/meterless/markovian (Apache-2.0, same commit)
